newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst -Dade Behring bourse listing in 98.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst -Dade Behring bourse listing in 98.

text.p: German chemicals group Hoechst AG said on Wednesday that its Dade Behring diagnostic joint venture unit would seek a bourse listing next year once cartel authorities have given their approval to the deal.
Hoechst's chief financial officer Klaus Schmieder said that the bourse listing, originally targeted for 1997, would have to be delayed until full cartel approval had been attained.
Behring Diagnostics recently signed an agreement to merge with Dade International and the merger is subject to approval by cartel authorities in both the United States and Europe.

The merged unit is forecast to report sales of over $1.5 billion. Hoechst will hold 32.5 percent of the joint venture. The rest will be held by Bain Capital, Goldman Sachs Capital Partners and Dade management.
